summary: Frontend-only E2E of the Real Audio Switch + Scribe Playback + Note-to-Patient features on encounter enc_80fea21b764e. All 8 acceptance flows pass: scribe section renders the real-audio SOAP draft (transcript_quality='fair', Arabic content, recorded-vs-stated BP conflict visible on soap-vital-*), Load Playback returns 200 and mounts scribe-player with a valid blob src, Sign SOAP works (confirm dialog accepted, soap-signature-line shown, patient-summary-panel appears), Draft Patient Summary generates in ~15s and defaults to Arabic (dir='rtl', Arabic script present in summary-discussed), summary-lang-en/summary-lang-ar toggle switches content and direction, summary-red-flags and summary-next-steps render, English 'What we discussed' edit persists after reload via debounced PATCH, Send to Patient publishes (summary-published-line shows 'Sent to the patient 8/20/2026, 1:40:49 PM', 0 textareas remain, send button gone). Patient (Omar) sees nav-visits 'Visit Summaries', /visits shows the published card with Dr. Layla Haddad, reason for visit 'Live Arabic audio test', edited English text via visit-lang-en, Arabic via visit-lang-ar (RTL), red-flag block present. No SOAP/clinical jargon leaks to patient view. Regression: patient /dashboard, /chat, /medications and doctor /doctor, /doctor/schedule all load cleanly with nav-visits present.
critical_code_review_comments: PatientSummaryPanel.jsx ListField: reduces `red_flags` to '' when the textarea is emptied on any keystroke (splits then filters empty lines). Minor UX quirk — pressing Enter twice removes an item silently. Not blocking.

ScribePanel.jsx loadPlayback: on failure it just clears audioUrl with no toast. If /api/audio/{id}/stream 401s or 500s the user sees the button vanish and nothing happens. Consider surfacing an error toast.
